directions.hypothesis: Covers published this pick for tonight's Islanders @ Maple Leafs game (7:10 PM EDT Oct 17). The case is that Matthews is healthy, has four goals in his last three games, and is converting a high share of his power-play shots. That case rests on a short hot streak and a 40% power-play shooting rate that is unlikely to last. The Covers writer also calls the Islanders defense stingy, which argues against the pick. It is only worth considering if Matthews' shot volume and power-play minutes hold up.
directions.question: Who starts in goal for the Islanders tonight? Is Matthews confirmed on the top power-play unit? And has his goal price already shortened from the published +120 because he has cashed in two straight games?

directions.hypothesis: Covers published this pick. The case is that Nylander has at least three shots on goal in four straight games and averages about 6.5 shot attempts per game, plus extra power-play chances against an undisciplined Islanders team. Four games is a small sample, and the line may have moved to 3.5 or gotten more expensive. The lead only holds if his shot attempts and power-play time are stable.
directions.question: Is the line still 2.5 at a similar price? Is Nylander on the first power-play unit and in his usual top-six role in tonight's projected lineup? Do the Islanders actually take an above-average number of penalties?
